entries.zh: 天景：天空景致；缀满星辰的天穹，天堂之景
entries.en: paradise of heaven; the starry firmament, heavenly scene

entries.zh: 匹：相配、匹配；结合（配成一对）
entries.en: to pair, match; to join, come together (parearse/juntarse)

entries.zh: 對：成对、相配；（引申）相对、相应
送：致送、赠送；（婚嫁语境）撮合送合成对
entries.en: to give, deliver; to join (in marriage), pair off
entries.notes: 送 本义致送，其配对义系据婚嫁撮合语境（送嫁、送做堆类用法）推得，与 parearse 的对应依赖推断。

entries.zh: 匹配：匹配成双，如夫妻般相配
entries.en: to match as married couples; to pair off in marriage

entries.zh: 成對：成双成对；（事物）配成对
entries.en: to form pairs; paired things, in couples

entries.zh: 同：（两物）相同、相类，如同一面目
entries.en: of two things, to be alike, resemble each other; the same
entries.notes: M 栏第二音节 fāng 的对应汉字未见著录，R 栏 'duch cara' 非典型官话对音（疑为原文旁注），仅 同 字可确证。

entries.en: to resemble, be like; to look like

entries.zh: 宛：宛然、仿佛；多少有些相似
entries.en: to resemble in some way; to be somewhat like, as if

entries.zh: 照：依照、按照；正如、如同……（西语栏句末残缺）
entries.en: according to, as; as it seems that (Spanish gloss truncated in original)
entries.notes: 西语栏原文截断（[残]），全句义不明；据 照/chiâu（tsiàu）定依照、正如之义。

entries.zh: 惕（字形存疑，或作悼）：暂拟心中惕惧；确义无法定夺
entries.en: [character uncertain: 惕/悼] tentatively, to be apprehensive; sense unsettled
entries.notes: 汉字在 惕/悼 之间存疑（[疑]），音 suk 与两候选字形均难确合，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 量：思量、估量；心里以为、认为
entries.en: to think, reckon, consider; to be of the opinion that (piensa que)

entries.zh: 才貌過人：才干与容貌超出众人
entries.en: to excel others in talent and looks; to stand out above the rest

entries.zh: 出頭：出头、露头角；（显露身份境况）
entries.en: to stand out, come to the fore; to show one's condition or standing
entries.notes: 西语 condió 为 condición 之缩写，展开依赖推断；出头露面之义据汉字与闽南语栏确证。

entries.zh: 好首：相貌好、好看（仪表出众）
entries.en: good-looking, of fine appearance; to look well
entries.notes: 次字 首 与读音 cúa 不合且带污损号，好相貌之义主要依西语 de buen parecer 与 好 字推得。

entries.zh: 門面：门面、露脸（不遮掩面目地露面）；体面外观
entries.en: face, outward appearance; to show one's face openly

entries.zh: 照原：照原样、依旧；保持本来面目
entries.en: as before, the same as originally; to appear as it naturally is

entries.zh: 障親像：简直就像、一模一样，不多不少（首字 障/鄣 存疑）
entries.en: to be exactly alike, neither more nor less; just like
entries.notes: 首字在 障/鄣 之间存疑（[疑]）；西语 nima, nimenos 判读为 ni más, ni menos，义据 親像 与该语确认。
